main_text.p: gnatis proximis, quorūnive maximè interesset, ea iniri-& scribi, ac ad senatum signandi causâ referri. Nec in his hodiè quicquam mutatum.

De testamento nunc aliud jus ante annos aliquot inductum. Nam quibus ætatis anni sunt, si liberis legitimis carent, his de bonis suis omnibus non haereditariis, sed acquisitis, ni obstent pacta dotalia, testari liberè pro libitu licet: De haereditariis non nisi ex semisse licet. At quibus liberi legitimi sunt, totius substantiae suae semissem relinquere iisdem coguntur, nisi justam causam, senatuiq; probatam contra eos, aut eorum aliquem habeant. De altero semisse pro arbitrio suo disponere similiter servatis iisdem possunt. Sed in his omnibus opus, ut à sanis lectóve non affixis, ac mente integris id fiat, referaturque ad senatum, aut testantis manu scriptum senatui offeratur, & sigillo publico civitatis muniatur.

Quod si liberorum aliqui exhæredes scribuntur, his tamen ex fructibus partis suae alimenta debentur; pars ipsa liberis iporum, si quos habent, aut haeredibus proximis accrescit. In successionibus o-Leges de successionibus

page.notes: The margin note "Leges de successionibus" is printed in italic, split over two lines ("Leges de" / "successionibus"); the hyphen fragment "bus." at the end of the note is part of the same word. The catchword "lim" and the signature "P" are read from the foot. Some letters are worn: "maximè" and "interesset" were read with some uncertainty, and "fructibus" is printed with a worn ct ligature. The running head is written with "Urbe" in place of printed "Vrbe" according to the u/v rule. The paragraph breaks before "De testamento" and "Quod si" are read from run-in starts and line ends and may need checking.
